answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake bond before it can transact, forfeited if duplicate identities are proven. A grove of agents then resembles real trees, each rooted in its own costly plot, instead of cheap cuttings cloned for free. The bond is returned to honest agents, so legitimate newcomers are not priced out, while an attacker wanting a thousand fake lotus blooms must fund a thousand separate stakes, and losing even one saffron-stamped fraud case wipes out the profit.
